name: Fear
summary: 30-foot Cone: Wisdom save or drop what it holds and flee from you, Frightened, for up to 1 minute.
text: Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it drops whatever it is holding and has the Frightened condition for the duration. On each of its turns, a creature Frightened this way takes the Dash action and moves away from you by the safest route, unless it has nowhere to move. If it ends its turn in a space where it has no line of sight to you, it makes another Wisdom saving throw, and on a success the spell ends for it.
